text:
alana: heads-up — Harlequin Data flagged a billing spike on Dedicated for Feb. Invoice `INV-2026-0452`, they say we billed for 2x planned standby GPUs during an autoscale incident. can we approve a one-off offset?

miguel: can you share the reconciled usage and the requested amount? and do we have contract language for standby charges?

alana: reconciled usage attached in the ticket (see link), summary: expected committed run = 720 GPU-hours, billed = 1440 GPU-hours; customer says autoscale bug kept standby nodes alive for ~6h after failure. requesting credit of $12,400 to make them whole.

sam: pinging from sales — customer is on a year commit (S-ENTERPRISE-2025) and given the outage they have escalated. i'd prefer we offer a credit but cap it and note it's an exception (avoid setting precedent). what does legal say about contract clause 7.2?

sophia: GL for credits is 6405-CUST-CREDIT. if approved we need an accounting memo and the period to post is Feb 2026. also need to know if it's refundable or contra-revenue.

miguel: thanks. @alana can you paste the autoscale incident id and the logfile snippet that shows nodes stayed up? we should confirm it was our infra fault, not customer config.

alana: incident ID: INC-2026-1122. log snippet: ```
2026-02-18T03:12:01Z autoscaler: terminate-requested node-gtx-23
2026-02-18T03:18:35Z autoscaler: terminate-failed node-gtx-23 status=draining
2026-02-18T03:24:02Z autoscaler: terminate-requested node-gtx-23
2026-02-18T09:41:10Z autoscaler: terminate-succeeded node-gtx-23
```

alana: timeline -> node requested termination at 03:12, finally terminated at ~09:41; customer ran jobs during the 6h window and got billed. ops traced it to a bug in drain handler. ops PR merged and hotfix deployed same day.

miguel: ok that looks like our bug. sam — any customer goodwill comments? sales asks for full offset of the excess usage only, not the committed baseline. so $12.4k aligns with excess tokens.

sam: agreed to excess-only credit. we'll include a short note in renewal that this was a one-time operational exception. customer accepts that. :thumbsup:

sophia: accounting: please route credit to `6405-CUST-CREDIT`, post in Feb run, memo should reference `INV-2026-0452` and `INC-2026-1122`. we need approver initials on the memo.

miguel: approved by finance lead. miguel: +1 from me (finance lead).

alana: thanks — can @billing-bot apply `-12400` USD credit to `INV-2026-0452` and create memo draft?

billing-bot: invoice update queued: applying credit -12400 USD to `INV-2026-0452`. Posting will occur in next batch (EOD). Reference tags: `credit:harlequin-exception`, `memo:INC-2026-1122`.

sam: filing note for renewal team. alana, can you confirm the memo once billing-bot creates it?

alana: will review memo. tagging legal for awareness but no contract amendment needed per clause 7.2 exception path.

sophia: noted. i'll prepare the accounting entry and attach the memo to the month close folder.

miguel: recording decision here: one-off excess usage credit approved ($12,400) — document in ticket please. closing thread after memo posted.

alana: done, memo checked in ticket, billing-bot confirmed posting. thanks everyone :slightly_smiling_face:

billing-bot: invoice `INV-2026-0452` updated: credit posted (-12400 USD). audit id: AUD-2026-7788.
